a-code-ships-without-being-declared._: The exact regression this guard exists for: a permission ships and nobody declares that its Arabic was written by an agent, so the owner is silently credited with a line she has never seen. Simulated by dropping one entry, which makes the totals disagree by one in the same direction. Must fail the BALANCES test by name.

the-list-names-a-code-that-does-not-exis._: A renamed or withdrawn code left in the list would keep the balance arithmetic working while naming nothing — the one way this guard could pass while describing a fiction. Must fail the real-code test by name.
